headline: Uganda Requires $78 Billion to Finance Climate Commitments
summary: Uganda requires $78.1 billion over the next eight years to implement its climate commitments, with 85 percent of the financing expected to come from external sources, according to the Ministry of Water and Environment.
why: Large-scale developing nation climate funding requirements highlight sovereign debt and international development finance needs.
